items.quote: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, LORD, wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people?
items.claim: In the text, Moses returns to the LORD and asks why the LORD has treated the people so badly.

items.quote: why is it that thou hast sent me?
items.claim: In the text, Moses asks the LORD why he was sent at all.
items.action: questioned the purpose of his commission

items.quote: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people
items.claim: In the text, Moses says that since he spoke to Pharaoh in the LORD's name, Pharaoh has treated the people worse.
items.mechanism: Moses speaking to Pharaoh in the LORD's name was followed by Pharaoh treating the people worse

items.quote: neither hast thou delivered thy people at all
items.claim: In the text, Moses complains that the LORD has not delivered the people at all.
